name: ubuntu-24.04-server-cloudimg-amd64
verification: The release directory is dated, so the URL keeps naming the same bytes; the daily tree under /noble/<serial>/ is pruned after a few months.
guest/image-builder/build-golden.sh downloads SHA256SUMS from sha256sums_url and refuses to continue unless its line for sha256sums_entry equals sha256 above.
When gpgv and /usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-cloudimage-keyring.gpg are present it also checks SHA256SUMS against SHA256SUMS.gpg.
The downloaded image must hash to sha256 above; a cached copy is re-hashed before every build.
To move to a newer serial: update serial, the three URLs and sha256 together, taking sha256 from that directory's SHA256SUMS.
